description: Search active constituents (donors, members, volunteers, organizations). Give `name` and/or `email` for the common case, or raw `terms`. Available term fields: name, eaddr (email contains), phone_number, street, city, state (2-letter), postal_code, country, keyword (keyword id), updated_from / updated_to (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ), membership_status (0 lapsed, 1 active), membership_level (comma-separated ids), membership_end_date_from / _to (YYYY-MM-DD), external_id, constituent_type (0 individual, 1 organization), groups (comma-separated group ids), lists (comma-separated list ids), custom_attr (key|op|value). At least one term is required. LGL: GET /api/v1/constituents/search.

expand.description: Related records to include inline on each constituent.

limit.description: Number of entries to return, 1-100. LGL's default is 25.

offset.description: Start at this entry (0-based). Use the previous page's next_item. Default 0.

sort.description: Sort by name, external_id, lgl_id, date_created, date_updated, membership_level or membership_end_date_from. Append '!' to reverse (e.g. date_updated!).

terms.description: Extra raw LGL search terms, each 'field=value' (combined with AND). See the tool description for the available fields.

name: lgl_search_constituents
title: Search constituents
